answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake plus track record. Every identity must lock capital before it can grade, and one operator funding many wallets pays that stake once per fake seat, so extra accounts never get cheaper. Payouts return only to seats whose calls survive review, so a lagoon of idle accounts earns nothing and slashing makes each clone a liability. A fresh jade identity also carries near-zero weight until it builds a history of correct calls. Deception costs capital, lock time, and a record that is the pigment of real reputation.
